name: WebEffortless Membership Manager
author: WebEffortless

sections.description:
WebEffortless Membership Manager is a lightweight, enterprise-grade, and performance-optimized membership solution for WordPress and WooCommerce. Built with clean architecture and dedicated database tables, it enables you to launch recurring memberships, protect premium content, release drip courses, and offer member-only product discounts without slowing down your store.

Whether you run a digital course, a VIP customer club, a paid newsletter, or a wholesale store, WebEffortless Membership Manager provides all the tools you need in a fast, modern interface.

Key Highlights & Features

1. Flexible Membership Plans & Access Methods

  • Product Purchase Linkage: Automatically grant membership when customers purchase specific simple, variable, or subscription products.
  • Free Registration Tiers: Auto-grant plans when new users register an account.
  • Logged-In User Access: Grant membership perks to all registered and logged-in users on your site automatically.
  • Manual / Invite-Only Assignment: Create exclusive, invite-only VIP tiers managed directly by site administrators.
  • Customizable Duration: Offer lifetime/unlimited access or configure duration by days, months, or years.
  • Plan Priority System: Set hierarchical priority levels so higher-tier plans take precedence when rules overlap.

2. Granular Content Restriction

  • Post Types Protection: Restrict access to posts, pages, and any public custom post types (Courses, Lessons, Podcasts, Portfolios, etc.).
  • Taxonomy & Category Protection: Restrict entire categories, tags, or custom taxonomies with a single rule.
  • Single Post & Product Level: Protect specific articles or WooCommerce products.
  • Flexible Restriction Modes:
    • Teaser / Excerpt: Show a content teaser with a customizable member restriction box.
    • Stealth 404: Completely hide restricted content from non-members with a standard 404 response.
    • Redirect: Instantly redirect unauthorized visitors to a sales page, pricing table, or login URL.
    • Custom Message Replacement: Replace the content area with a custom HTML restriction message.
  • Editor Integration: Configure restriction rules, required plans, drip delays, and custom notices directly from the WordPress post editor sidebar.
  • Visual Lock Badges: Optional lock icon display on restricted content titles across archives and menus.

3. Intelligent Content Dripping Engine

  • Automated Schedule Unlocks: Release restricted lessons, chapters, or files gradually over time based on when the customer joined (e.g. unlock Week 2 content after 7 days).
  • Flexible Time Units: Set drip delay intervals in days, weeks, months, or years.
  • Member Timeline View: Customers can view their upcoming content drip schedule directly inside their account dashboard.

4. Member-Exclusive Product Discounts

  • Custom Discount Rules: Offer special pricing on selected WooCommerce products or entire product categories for active members.
  • Discount Types: Configure percentage discounts (e.g. 15% off) or fixed amount discounts (e.g. $10 off).
  • Intelligent Discount Stacking: Choose how multiple discounts are handled (highest discount only, lowest discount only, stack all, or first matching).
  • Sale Product Protection: Option to exclude products already on sale from additional member discounts.
  • Live Price Display: Automatically displays member savings on product and shop pages for logged-in members.

5. Member Account Dashboard (WooCommerce My Account)

  • Native Account Portal: Adds a dedicated “Memberships” tab inside WooCommerce My Account.
  • Membership Details Page: View active plan details, expiration dates, linked orders, and content unlock schedules.
  • Self-Service Controls: Allow members to pause, resume, or cancel active memberships directly from their account (configurable via admin settings).
  • Pricing Grid Shortcode: Embed responsive pricing and membership plan cards anywhere with [wemem_plans].

6. Lifecycle Email Notifications

  • 7 Automated Email Triggers:
    • Welcome Email (first activation)
    • Membership Activated / Re-activated
    • Expiry Reminder (sent N days before expiration)
    • Membership Expired
    • Membership Cancelled
    • Membership Paused
    • Membership Renewed
  • Dynamic Template Tags: Personalize subject lines and email bodies with {user_name}, {plan_name}, {start_date}, {end_date}, {days_until_expiry}, {dashboard_url}, and {site_name}.
  • Branding & Testing: Customize email accent color, sender name, sender address, and send instant test emails from the admin settings.

7. Real-Time Analytics & Reporting

  • Interactive Chart Visualizations: Real-time net growth charts and active vs. cancelled membership distribution doughnut charts powered by local Chart.js.
  • Preset & Custom Date Ranges: Filter reports by Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, This Year, or Custom date intervals.
  • Comparative Analytics: Compare metrics against previous periods to monitor retention and churn trends.
  • One-Click CSV Export: Export complete membership reports to CSV for bookkeeping, CRM synchronization, and financial reporting.

8. High Performance & Developer Friendly

  • Custom Database Schema: Optimized dedicated tables (wemem_plans, wemem_access_rules, wemem_member_activity_log) ensure zero postmeta query slowdowns.
  • WooCommerce HPOS Compatible: Built from the ground up for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
  • WooCommerce Block Checkout Ready: Fully compatible with modern Block checkout and cart layouts.
  • REST API Endpoints: Custom REST API routes for headless setups, mobile apps, and third-party integrations.
  • GDPR & Privacy Compliant: Zero external CDNs or remote font calls; all assets and libraries are hosted locally on your server.
  • 100% Translation Ready: Includes complete .pot localization template and en_US translation files.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for WebEffortless Membership Manager.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the webeffortless-membership-manager folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate WebEffortless Membership Manager through the Plugins menu in WordPress admin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WebEffortless Membership Manager is built as a WooCommerce extension and requires WooCommerce 8.0 or higher to be active.

Can I restrict custom post types and custom taxonomies?

Yes. WebEffortless Membership Manager works with standard WordPress posts and pages, as well as any public custom post types (courses, portfolios, events) and custom taxonomies (course categories, project types).

How does content dripping work?

Content dripping allows you to release restricted content on a schedule relative to the member’s registration date. For example, you can set a drip rule of 14 days, meaning the content remains locked until the user has held an active membership for at least two weeks.

Can I offer member-exclusive discounts on products?

Yes. You can create discount rules that apply percentage or fixed price reductions to specific products or entire product categories for members of selected plans.

Are customers able to cancel or pause their memberships?

Yes. Store owners can enable customer self-service controls in the settings, allowing members to pause or cancel their active memberships directly from the WooCommerce My Account area.

Is WebEffortless Membership Manager compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. WebEffortless Membership Manager is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and standard post tables.

Does the plugin make any external requests or track data?

No. WebEffortless Membership Manager respects user privacy and complies with GDPR. All scripts, styles, and chart libraries are bundled locally, and no data is sent to external servers.

Can I translate the plugin into other languages?

Yes. WebEffortless Membership Manager is fully internationalized and includes a standard webeffortless-membership-manager.pot translation template in the /languages directory.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial official release.
  • Added unlimited membership plans with product purchase, free registration, logged-in user, and manual access methods.
  • Added granular content restriction for posts, pages, custom post types, and taxonomy categories.
  • Added content dripping engine with day, week, month, and year release intervals.
  • Added member-exclusive product discounts with percentage and fixed amount support and stacking logic.
  • Added customer membership portal inside WooCommerce My Account.
  • Added real-time Chart.js analytics reports with period comparisons and CSV export.
  • Added 7 automated lifecycle email notifications with dynamic placeholder tags.
  • Added standalone [wemem_plans] pricing table shortcode.
  • Declared full compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS and Block Checkout.
  • Bundled complete .pot localization template and en_US translation files.
